topics.title: AI stock sell-off rattles markets
topics.summary: Global markets were pressured as investors reassessed costly AI and data-center bets amid high interest rates. Tech shares led the declines while traders weighed how durable the investment boom may be.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a hot new technology starts looking expensive, are you the type to ride it out, take the profits, or avoid the drama entirely?

topics.title: Study links warmer seas to Hurricane Polo
topics.summary: A new attribution study found human-caused warming and El Niño both helped intensify Hurricane Polo, with warming identified as the larger contributor. Researchers say the findings sharpen questions about preparing for stronger storms.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a weather warning feel real to you: a forecast map, a friend’s story, or seeing local preparations begin?

topics.title: Atlantic current study offers cautious hope
topics.summary: A Danish-led study suggests the Atlantic’s major ocean-current system could recover after severe weakening if the climate cools. Researchers stress that real-world uncertainty remains and changes could still last centuries.
topics.discussionPrompt: Does a little scientific good news make you feel more motivated to act, or mostly curious to learn what the fine print is?

topics.title: Poland’s economy changes the migration story
topics.summary: The Guardian reports that Poland’s rise into the world’s top 20 economies is helping reverse a long-running brain drain, although higher living costs remain part of the picture.
topics.discussionPrompt: What would make you move back to a hometown you once left: better pay, family nearby, or just a feeling that the place had changed?

topics.title: Brazil trims its standard workweek
topics.summary: Brazil has cut its workweek to 40 hours, a move framed as a win for workers ahead of the country’s election runoff. Employers and employees are now watching how schedules and pay adapt.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your workweek lost a few hours, would you spend the extra time resting, learning something new, or making ambitious weekend plans?

topics.title: Rotterdam’s bin lorries get poetic recognition
topics.summary: Rotterdam’s poetry-covered garbage trucks have received cultural status, turning an everyday city service into an unusual point of civic pride and conversation.
topics.discussionPrompt: What everyday vehicle or building in your town deserves an unexpectedly artistic makeover?

topics.title: Jobless claims edge up in the U.S.
topics.summary: New U.S. jobless claims rose by 1,000 to 199,000 in the latest weekly report. The modest increase landed as markets also tracked inflation and consumer spending.
topics.discussionPrompt: When people talk about the economy, do jobs, grocery prices, or interest rates feel most connected to your everyday life?

topics.title: Canada’s women prepare for England challenge
topics.summary: Canada’s women’s rugby team is preparing for a double-header against England, who have gone 41 matches unbeaten. The series offers Canada a high-profile test ahead of future international competition.
topics.discussionPrompt: Do you cheer harder for an underdog facing a huge streak, or do you secretly enjoy watching a dominant team try to keep the magic going?

topics.title: FIFAe finals postponed in Jeddah
topics.summary: FIFA and the Saudi Esports Federation postponed the FIFAe Finals that were scheduled for October 16–25 in Jeddah, citing recent attacks on Saudi Arabia. Organizers have not set a new date.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a big esports event gets delayed, do you prefer a quick reschedule, or would you rather organizers wait until they can make it feel properly special?

topics.title: Gaël Monfils retires from professional tennis
topics.summary: Former world No. 6 Gaël Monfils has retired from professional tennis at age 40, according to the International Tennis Integrity Agency. His departure closes a long, crowd-pleasing career.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which athlete or performer would you love to see take one final victory lap before calling it a career?
